about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: A developer in constant evolution
about.bio: I chose programming driven by the curiosity that the possibilities of this world sparked in me. Over time, I discovered something that captivated me: the ability to turn an idea into something tangible. I'm not just talking about writing code — I'm talking about sitting down and chatting with you, understanding what you need, and building something that actually works in your day-to-day. Turning a client's concern into a tool used every day is one of the things that makes me enjoy this work the most.

commitment.title: Commitment
commitment.description: I treat the projects I take on as if they were my own. If I care about what I'm building, the result shows it.

communication.title: Communication
communication.description: With me, the conversation is fluid, effective, and comfortable. Technical decisions don't hide behind jargon: what I decide, I explain.

honesty.title: Honesty
honesty.description: If I don't know something, I say so and learn it. If a solution carries risks, I name them before they show up.

robustness.title: Robustness over speed
robustness.description: I'd rather have a small change well done than a fast delivery that inherits debt. Building it right today saves refactoring tomorrow.

productVision.title: Product vision
productVision.description: What I build is used by someone — that person is the compass, not the trendy tech of the quarter.

hobbies.title: Outside of code
hobbies.description: Curious and restless by nature. I enjoy having open fronts in my life that challenge me. Sport has been a constant pillar: I practiced taekwondo, played football and futsal, have been training at the gym for years, and play padel every week for the last couple of years. I've played the violin since primary school and it still walks with me. Body and mind pull from the same cart: if you care for one, the other answers.

arynstal.title: Arynstal — Corporate website & CRM
arynstal.description: Complete system for an installation company: corporate website, lead capture, admin panel with audit trail, role-based access control, and automated notifications. System deployed and operating in production. Public release at arynstal.es is pending the delivery of the project gallery by the client.
arynstal.stack: Django 6, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Nginx, Gunicorn, Cloudflare

setlog.title: SetLog — Mobile training app
setlog.description: Native app to log gym sessions without breaking the flow. No login, no cloud account — designed so that pen and paper stop being more comfortable than the phone. Active construction with clean architecture: pure TypeScript domain, Feature-Sliced Design, and local-first persistence.
setlog.stack: Expo, React Native, strict TypeScript, Zustand, Zod, NativeWind

vault.title: Personal Vault + Project Exocortex
vault.description: A living system for managing technical and operational knowledge. Zettelkasten in Obsidian with a custom taxonomy + persistent cross-session memory via MCP. Project Exocortex (in evolution): RAG system over the vault so that knowledge gets activated semantically the moment it becomes relevant.
vault.stack: Obsidian, Markdown, MCP (Engram), RAG architecture in development

portfolio.title: Personal Portfolio
portfolio.description: This very site. Custom i18n system in vanilla JavaScript, responsive design, optimized accessibility, and careful performance.

testimonial.quote: From the very first moment, collaborating on the product creation was very straightforward. Carlos understood the needs and the business vision. We are very grateful for the tool he is building for the company.
testimonial.author: Arynstal SL

process.title: How I Work
process.subtitle: My work framework, phase by phase

understand.title: Understand
understand.description: Concept before code. I listen to what you need, ask about what's unclear, and make sure I understand the root problem. Saving a day by understanding well usually saves a week of refactoring.

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: I draw up a concrete plan and specify each change before touching anything: what's done, in what order, what you'll receive, and under which quality criteria. Spec-Driven Development as a baseline. No surprises.

develop.title: Develop
develop.description: I build the code step by step, with testing where it adds value and traceable commits. Every decision, gotcha, or lesson gets recorded in my knowledge vault — which means every project benefits from the learning of the previous ones.

deliver.title: Deliver
deliver.description: I hand you a tool you can actually use, with the documentation and manuals needed for its operation. Available to keep collaborating from the moment of delivery onwards.

contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: Have an idea you want to create?
contact.description: I'm available for freelance projects, collaborations, or full-time positions. If you have an idea or need help with your project, reach out.
